types.name: VoiceOrbProps
types.doc: The face of a voice assistant. One orb shows who has the floor: it rests when idle, opens outlined rings while it listens, spins an arc while it thinks and fills with the accent while it speaks. Rings and the five bars follow `level`.

members.name: state
members.doc: Who has the floor. Drives the colors, the rings and how the bars move.

members.name: level
members.doc: Loudness from 0 to 1 (microphone while listening, playback while speaking). Pass a motion value to update it every frame without re-rendering.

members.name: size
members.doc: Diameter of the whole orb, rings included, in pixels.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the orb. The current state is announced after it.

members.name: showLabel
members.doc: Shows the state caption under the orb. When false the state is still announced to assistive technology.

members.name: stateLabels
members.doc: Caption per state, to translate or reword the defaults.

members.name: onPress
members.doc: Makes the orb a button, for example to start listening or to interrupt the answer.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
